relationships.subject: suzetrigine
relationships.evidence_quote: Suzetrigine required the strongest depolarizations for relief (midpoint +33 mV) and relief was slow (tau >300 ms at +20 mV), so almost no relief occurred during an AP waveform.

relationships.subject: A-887826
relationships.evidence_quote: A-887826 inhibition was substantially relieved by AP waveforms applied at 20 Hz at 37°C.

relationships.subject: LTGO-33
relationships.evidence_quote: In contrast, there was no relief during AP trains with suzetrigine (VX-548) or LTGO-33, even though inhibition could be effectively removed by long, strong depolarizations.

key_findings: Inhibition of Nav1.8 by A-887826 is relieved during 20 Hz AP trains at 37 C, whereas suzetrigine and LTGO-33 show no use-dependent relief.
The compounds differ in depolarization midpoint for relief (suzetrigine +33 mV, A-887826 +13 mV, LTGO-33 -11 mV) and in reinhibition kinetics.
